title: Final Expression for R
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express R as a function of L for the circular orbit.

title: Final Expression for T
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the period T as a function of L.

title: Stability Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should identify which solution for R is stable and provide reasoning.

title: Expression for delta
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide an approximate expression for delta(t) in part (b).

title: Expression for phi
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression for phi(t) in part (c).

title: Use of Effective Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the effective potential concept in their calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about stability.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout their calculations.
